# SafeGen

> Do Not Connect register of Australian children's phone numbers. Platforms check a number before letting it open or link an account. Raw numbers are never stored.

## Start here

- https://ricricho.github.io/safegen-docs/docs/agent-discovery.html — full walkthrough for visiting agents
- https://www.safegen.com.au/api-docs — API reference
- https://www.safegen.com.au/developers/sign-up — self-serve test account, test key issued at once
- https://ricricho.github.io/safegen-docs/agent.json — machine-readable summary

## API (base https://www.safegen.com.au)

- POST /api/integrations/signup {orgName, contactName, contactEmail, website} -> 201 {accountId, testApiKey (shown once), rateLimitPerHour: 60}; duplicate email -> 409
- POST /api/check {phone} with Authorization: Bearer <key> -> {listed, blockRequested, action: reject|allow|unknown, checkedAt}; no key -> 401
- Test keys accept only fixture:match, fixture:no-match, fixture:no-block, fixture:unknown, fixture:error (503); real numbers -> 400 test_fixtures_only
- POST /api/integrations/request-production with the test key -> 202 production_pending; SafeGen reviews the organisation and issues a production key

## Reading results

- action reject: refuse the account link
- action allow: carry on with your normal checks (not proof of adulthood)
- action unknown or an error: hold for retry or review

## Offline practice kit

- https://github.com/RicRicho/safegen-evaluation-kit (MIT): node --test test.mjs; node example.mjs
